target.title: fix(together): apply configured request policy to video generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Together video generation currently ignores "models.providers.together.request" overrides (headers, allowPrivateNetwork, dispatcherPolicy). Users who configure a request policy for Together see it applied to chat/completion providers but not to video generation, so private-network access, custom headers, and dispatcher routing are dropped on the floor.

## Why This Change Was Made

Mirror the pattern already used by openai, pixverse, google image generation, and Alix-007's recent video request-policy PRs: pass "sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest(providerConfig?.request)" into "resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig" so the configured transport overrides flow into the create request.

## Changes

- "extensions/together/video-generation-provider.ts"
  - Import "sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest".
  - Read "req.cfg?.models?.providers?.together".
  - Forward the sanitized request policy to "resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig".
- "extensions/together/video-generation-provider.test.ts"
  - Add regression test asserting that configured request overrides reach the HTTP resolver.

## Intentionally Out of Scope

- Poll/download stages continue to use the headers resolved at create time; this change does not refactor them onto "fetchWithTimeoutGuarded", matching the minimal scope of the existing video request-policy PRs.
- No new helper or shared abstraction is introduced.

## Evidence

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/together/video-generation-provider.test.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/together/video-generation-provider.ts extensions/together/video-generation-provider.test.ts
```

- Vitest: 9/9 passing.
- tsgo: no type errors.
- oxlint: clean.
